resellerBots.webhookNotRemoved: the bot was removed and its token revoked, but the messenger could not be told. It may keep trying for a while; nothing reaches you.

errors.token: paste the token the messenger gave you (up to 200 characters).

refusals.not_allowed: you may not configure this reseller.
refusals.reseller_suspended: this reseller is suspended; its bots cannot be changed until that is lifted.
refusals.reseller_terminated: this reseller is closed and takes no further changes.
refusals.invalid_token: the messenger does not know this token. Copy it again from BotFather.
refusals.primary_exists: this reseller already has a bot on this messenger. Remove it first.
refusals.vault_unavailable: bot tokens cannot be stored on this deployment right now. Try again later.
